setup_root: mathprofile::Root("dspec_setup", -1) encloses input/model/frequency initialization, SEM construction, sample and optional native-grid preparation, streams, coordinate export and caches. It closes before the first candidate root.
candidate_root: mathprofile::Root("dspec", objective) encloses one candidate API call and local destruction; its scope ends before the diagnostic reference call.

stages.setup_all: Inclusive total of driver setup before candidate roots. Exclusive remainder is argument validation, path/environment checks, and setup control/bookkeeping not called out separately.
stages.parameter_file_generation: Writes the temporary parameter file consumed by InputParametersNew.
stages.input_parameters_model_and_frequency_ini: InputParametersNew construction, model/input parser, source/event metadata and frequency setup.
stages.SEM_mesh_and_matrix_setup: Full1D::SEM construction from the loaded Earth model and source, including mesh and system matrix/preconditioner setup performed by the constructor.
stages.sample_CSV_read: Reads the requested sample CSV into the working point grid.
stages.native_grid_expansion: When native mode is selected, forms unique sample angles and expands element/GLL-node radial traces into the tensor-product point grid.
stages.result_stream_creation_and_coordinate_ex: Opens candidate/reference/coordinate streams and writes the coordinate binary before solving.
stages.stream_packet_and_cache_bookkeeping: Configures optional packet stream and initializes response, sampling-plan and forward-field cache objects before candidate roots.
stages.frequency_workspace_and_modal_solve: Per-bin workspace creation outside the modal loops; includes modal projection, source treatment/lift, receiver map preparation, and block capture.
stages.shared_forward_and_adjoint_solver: One family/degree/frequency solve path; counts degree and forward, weighted-adjoint, and unit-basis RHS widths.
stages.dynamic_H_assembly: FixedMeshAdjointSolver::systemMatrix for current complex frequency and family.
stages.sparse_factorization_total: Copied EquilibratedSparseLU::compute; wrapper total, with exact Eigen SparseLU analyzePattern then factorize call order retained.
stages.sparse_equilibration_and_scaling: Copied EquilibratedSparseLU row scaling and D H D matrix construction.
stages.sparse_symbolic_analysis: Eigen SparseLU analyzePattern on the equilibrated matrix.
stages.sparse_numerical_factorization: Eigen SparseLU factorize on that same equilibrated matrix.
stages.forward_substitution: EquilibratedSparseLU forward solve, including RHS/result diagonal scaling.
stages.full_weighted_HH_solve: Full receiver-weighted Hermitian-adjoint solve when the non-batch branch is used.
stages.minimal_unit_basis_HH_solve: Rank-minimal receiver basis Hermitian-adjoint solve on the shared-factor non-batch route.
stages.batch_response_cache_get_or_compute: Exact-key lookup, signatures, and response cache miss computation; records cache hit/miss and input RHS widths.
stages.batch_weighted_adjoint_reconstruction: Exact unit-basis QR reconstruction of requested weighted RHS and response mixing.
stages.receiver_basis_and_QR_reconstruction: Exact rank-minimal receiver row selection, QR solves, reconstruction matrix; records input and selected basis dimensions.
stages.modal_projection_source_lift_and_frequen: Radial, spheroidal and toroidal modal families; source/lift coefficients, receiver projection, and solver calls. This is a family-level scope, not per-point arithmetic.
stages.radial_l0_source_and_adjoint_branch: The existing radial degree-zero source and adjoint path.
stages.pole_frame_sampling_total: Enclosing pole-frame coefficient sampling for the volume and receiver grid.
stages.radial_l0_sampling_and_interpolation: Radial-only modal sampling, including the l=0 branch.
stages.radial_interpolation_and_strain_numerato: Radial coefficient construction using existing interpolation plans and r-strain numerators; one scope per existing coefficient-build batch.
stages.tensor_grid_semantic_plan_and_sampling: Tensor sampling call including exact grid address plan creation/reuse and sample reconstruction.
stages.tensor_sampling_total: Tensor contraction route; nested scopes and counters separate plan, basis, packing, GEMM and scatter work.
stages.tensor_angular_gemm_complex_and_packing: Complex-basis synthesis wrapper; dimensions and batch count are reported separately from actual ZGEMM.
stages.actual_ZGEMM_complex: Actual CBLAS ZGEMM; records one complex matrix product dimension triplet and contributes m*n*k to tensor_actual_gemm_macs.
stages.tensor_angular_gemm_real_and_packing: Real-degree synthesis wrapper; dimensions and batch count are reported separately from actual DGEMM.
stages.actual_DGEMM_real_part: Actual CBLAS DGEMM for the real component; contributes m*n*k to tensor_actual_gemm_macs.
stages.actual_DGEMM_imag_part: Actual CBLAS DGEMM for the imaginary component; contributes m*n*k to tensor_actual_gemm_macs.
stages.tensor_coefficient_packing_and_key_reord: Per-component tensor radial coefficient packing and ordered (m,l) key handling.
stages.tensor_phase_spin_rotation_and_scatter: Tensor field azimuthal phase, spin frame rotation and scatter to requested grid points.
stages.forward_angular_cache_lookup: Exact-key cross-objective forward tensor field cache lookup; hit/miss counters are candidate-root scoped.
stages.forward_angular_cache_store: Retained forward volume strain and receiver displacement insertion on miss.
stages.receiver_suffix_and_frequency_scatter: Receiver displacement suffix extraction and raw spectrum bin write.
stages.point_kernel_contraction_and_scatter: Existing pointKernel formula and aggregate point-kernel scatter over the complete volume batch.
stages.source_contact_separate_case: Existing sourceShellContact evaluation measured separately from volume point kernels.
stages.Pforward_fft_and_window: WindowedDisplacementMap::forward, including damping/window and FFT transform.
stages.final_frequency_objective_accumulation: Final weighted spectrum inner product and scalar objective.
stages.candidate_api_including_local_cleanup: Caller API duration including candidate function return/local cleanup. Its exclusive remainder is candidate work not placed in narrower scopes: allocations, input/key/map bookkeeping, value copies and moves, per-bin bookkeeping, and destruction. Profile serialization itself is outside this scope and included in candidate_call_wall_s.
stages.tensor_sampling_total_exclusive: Remaining tensor-route exclusive time covers local key/record/result bookkeeping, point map access, and local destruction not captured by the named stages; it is reported directly and not attributed to arithmetic.
stages.tensor_grid_semantic_key_build_and_looku: Builds the exact semantic volume-grid key and performs its cache lookup; excludes cold layout construction.
stages.tensor_grid_cold_layout_map_build: On grid-cache miss, validates and constructs radial-trace, shared-angle, and point maps, then admits or retains the layout.
stages.tensor_representative_and_coefficient_re: Builds representative points, samples pole frames and captures coefficient records through the existing visitor.
stages.tensor_result_allocation_and_volume_tagg: Allocates the result vector and tags volume points with radial element and fluid metadata.
stages.tensor_angular_plan_key_build_and_lookup: Builds the frame/grid angular-plan key and looks up the cached plan.
stages.tensor_cold_frame_geometry_and_wigner_bu: On angular-plan miss, computes tangent frame rotations and constructs/populates the Wigner table and plan.
stages.tensor_complex_basis_cold_fill_and_cache: On complex-basis miss, allocates/fills the angular matrix and optionally admits it to the basis cache.
stages.tensor_real_basis_cold_fill_and_cache: On real-basis miss, allocates/fills the angular matrix and optionally admits it to the basis cache.
stages.tensor_radial_l0_scatter: Adds the reserved radial degree-zero forward/adjoint strain record to each volume result.
stages.tensor_forward_cache_copy_and_receiver_s: Copies cached forward volume strain and receiver displacement into the current result when the exact forward cache hits.
stages.tensor_receiver_suffix_sampling_and_scat: Samples receiver points through the existing packed route and copies radial/fluid tags and forward displacement into the receiver suffix.
stages.tensor_complex_basis_key_construction: Directly constructs and fills the semantic complex-basis key vector through a return-value lambda; preserves original vector construction while timing key formation.
stages.tensor_complex_basis_cache_lookup: Looks up the direct-constructed complex-basis key in the current angular plan basis map.
stages.tensor_real_basis_key_construction: Directly constructs and fills the semantic real-basis key vector through a return-value lambda; preserves original vector construction while timing key formation.
stages.tensor_real_basis_cache_lookup: Looks up the direct-constructed real-basis key in the current angular plan basis map.

excluded_or_separately_timed.main_setup_s: External driver wall duration through creation of per-run caches, before candidate roots. The nested dspec_setup profile root breaks this interval into named stages; root serialization is included in this wall duration.
excluded_or_separately_timed.candidate_call_wall_s: Wall duration around candidate root, includes profiler serialization in active mode.
excluded_or_separately_timed.candidate_s: Existing candidate-internal total set just before return, and so excludes return/local cleanup and profile serialization.
excluded_or_separately_timed.reference_s: Same-engine reference evaluation after candidate root teardown.
excluded_or_separately_timed.reference_validation_compare_s: Output comparison work after the reference call.
excluded_or_separately_timed.auditprofile: All legacy auditprofile timers are disabled with DSFAST_DISABLE_PROFILE in both clones.
excluded_or_separately_timed.threading: Use OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 and OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 so the thread-local root covers the full candidate math path.
excluded_or_separately_timed.tensor_actual_gemm_macs: Counter equal to the sum of m*n*k for each actual CBLAS GEMM invocation; real synthesis contributes separate real and imaginary DGEMMs.
